concerns.text: FR-008 states "System MUST generate three deliverables: `taxa_correlations.csv`, `mixed_effects_summary.csv`, `permutation_pvalues.csv`, and a PDF summary report `PD_microbiome_progression_report.pdf` (mandatory)." The count (three) contradicts the listed items (four).

Multiple functional requirements (FR-001 through FR-010) reference user‑story IDs such as "See US‑1", "See US‑2", etc., but the specification only defines "User Story 1", "User Story 2", … without assigning US‑1, US‑2 identifiers. These cross‑references resolve to non‑existent IDs, breaking traceability.
